body:
console.okemily.com replaces the broken /admin/nock/code subpath (code-server has no base-path support, confirmed live). Workspace trust disabled. New /admin/openexecutive status+provisioning page shipped; found and fixed a real permission-registration gap (openexec.read/openexec.admin never existed as DB rows, so the provision endpoint had silently failed closed since it was added) and a hardcoded-localhost JWKSUrl bug. All changes deployed live and verified end-to-end against the running binary, not just tested in isolation. Commits: d90e1ab, ad0f09e, 33bd758, bf7e90a.

⚓ ☃
title: NOCK code-server fixed + OpenExecutive Back Office page shipped (S486, S506)
